Jan 2020
Some very nice people who care about their food and their customers. It is refreshing stopping in once or twice a week for a piece of fresh pizza, also one of the few places you can get good pizza by the slice, so you dont have to buy a whole Pizza if you dont need a whole pizza. Good for grabbing a slice on the run as well! Perhaps my favorite point about this place is the atmosphere. The owners, staff and customers are all respectful & positive, the mood is special there.
